title: Workflow Trigger
description: Maps a split_rule outcome to the downstream process/workflow that should be started for the resulting sub-order.

split_rule.description: References the split_rule.id this trigger fires for.

trigger.description: Where this hands off to a warehouse, reference the same id Warehouse-as-Code's elements/process_types.yaml uses (e.g. 'pick_task', 'putaway_task', 'cross_dock_task') rather than inventing a parallel vocabulary - see README 'Shared Vocabulary'.
